أنخفض (form VII)
# أَنْخَفِضُ (ʔanḵafiḍu) /ʔan.xa.fi.dˤu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْخَفَضَ (inḵafaḍa)
# أَنْخَفِضَ (ʔanḵafiḍa) /ʔan.xa.fi.dˤa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْخَفَضَ (inḵafaḍa)
# أَنْخَفِضْ (ʔanḵafiḍ) /ʔan.xa.fidˤ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْخَفَضَ (inḵafaḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
